authorization.basis: The user approved Phase B. V1 job 329837 fail-closed on the mass-conservation and differentiability gates because of the rejected CIC implementation. V2 is an in-scope implementation correction, retains every numerical tolerance and the same truth, and cannot expand science scope.

purpose: Correct only the rejected RSD deposition in the one-seed Phase-B mechanics smoke: use a conservative C1 TSC kernel and population-separated pushes. All original V1 scientific firewalls and numerical tolerances remain unchanged.

Phase_A_datum.read_contract: read raw_selection_exposure only; counts_all, counts_train, and counts_holdout are forbidden

external_population_prior.source: Lavaux and Jasche, Unmasking the Masked Universe: the 2M++ catalogue through Bayesian eyes, MNRAS 455 (2016) 3169, Table 1 in arXiv:1509.05040 source
external_population_prior.volume_rescaling: multiply published mean count per 2.34375 cMpc/h voxel by (12/2.34375)^3 before taking alpha=log(Nbar)
external_population_prior.prior_width_semantics: broad technical smoke prior covering resolution, sample-definition, and model differences; it is not frozen for actual inference

mock.truth_source: the completed fixed-design smoke fields are reused bit-for-bit

model.eta_gauge: eta=T*w-mean(T*w); the density monopole is fixed before alpha is applied
model.line_of_sight: observer-centred and position dependent at every source cell; plane parallel is forbidden
model.deposition: periodic conservative C1 triangular-shaped-cloud push; each population is scattered separately; an autodiff VJP adjoint is tested
model.boundary: selection has radial support inside the observer-centred sphere; require maximum truth displacement strictly below the 12 cMpc/h sphere-to-periodic-face margin
model.selection_application: raw order-6 angular-times-radial exposure is applied after the real-to-redshift-space mass push
model.selection_discretization_control: evaluate order-4 and order-6 truth intensities and report their relative L1 difference; do not claim convergence
model.count_likelihood: exact conditional Poisson, no Gaussian count approximation and no renormalization to observed totals
model.CF4_likelihood: existing fixed-geometry BGc Gaussian radial-velocity mock factor using its per-row mean model and sigma_v, with four standardized nuisance parameters
model.FoG: disabled in this matched coherent-RSD mechanics smoke; required in later stress arms
model.overdispersion: disabled in this matched Poisson mechanics smoke; required as a later stress arm
model.RSD_differentiability: TSC is C1 across nearest-cell boundaries and is tested by central finite differences at the zero-field initial state that exposed the V1 CIC cusp

mechanics.optimizer: scipy L-BFGS-B using the exact JAX gradient
mechanics.HMC_semantics: mechanics-only transitions; no convergence, coverage, posterior, or promotion claim

prior_dominated_label.semantics: predeclared Phase-B exposure-information proxy only, not a recovered-mode or observational-resolution label
